title: Magnetic Field Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the magnetic induction B must be correctly derived and include the appropriate variables.

title: Direction of B
description: Important Criteria: The direction of the magnetic field B at point P should be correctly identified as being in the azimuthal direction.

title: EMF Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The expression for the electromotive force epsilon must be correctly stated and related to the magnetic field.

title: Experimental Setup Sketch
description: Important Criteria: A clear and accurate sketch of the experimental arrangement should be provided, showing the loop and oscilloscope connections.

title: Signal Estimation
description: Optional Criteria: An estimation of the signal detected by the oscilloscope should be included, demonstrating understanding of the relationship between B and epsilon.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: Common errors include incorrect units for B or epsilon, which should be checked for consistency.

title: Sign Mistakes
description: Pitfall Criteria: Watch for sign mistakes in the expressions for B and epsilon, particularly in the cosine term.
